name: Caelus Anchorpoint intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

c4.say: Take a gyro stabilizer — Neptune's storms chew up dirtsider ships for breakfast. And traveler? Whatever the Gyre is building out there, the invoices say it's nearly finished.

c2j.say: Carefully. ...You want the relay logs. They all do, eventually. You'd think we were the only honest router in the outer system. We are.

c1.say: Welcome to Caelus Anchorpoint. Yes, the station is sideways. No, we will not fix it. How can we help?

options.label: Logs
options.text: I need your relay logs — command bursts headed to Neptune.

options.label: Joke
options.text: How do you even pour coffee sideways?

c2.say: Command bursts to the Gyre Collective every six hours, origin masked. But the BILLING ledger isn't masked, and every account roots back to one rock: Pluto.
